speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. You are presenting with a psychiatric condition and a new onset movement disorder; to begin our evaluation, how old are you and for how long have you noticed these movement symptoms? Additionally, have you been diagnosed with any specific psychiatric conditions prior to this?

speaker: Patient
text: 23-year-old college student. The patient is here for a follow-up appointment. He was recently diagnosed with schizophrenia and started on risperidone approximately 2 months ago. Reports a significant improvement in psychiatric symptoms since the start of treatment.

speaker: Doctor

That is a very relevant history, as risperidone can cause movement disorders. What specific type of movements are you experiencing, such as tremors, stiffness, or involuntary twisting, and when did they start relative to starting the medication?

DIAGNOSIS READY: Antipsychotic-induced Extrapyramidal Symptoms (EPS)
